references.text: Samson grabs the two central pillars and brings down the temple over the Philistines, fulfilling his intention expressed in verse 26
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson and gave him supernatural strength, the same power that would be used in his final act
The Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon Samson and gave him strength to perform great deeds, a pattern that repeats throughout his life
Samson had been blinded and captured, but his hair began to grow again, preparing him for his final test of strength
Samson's prayer to God for strength one last time, which directly follows up on his request in verse 26
Samson is mentioned among the heroes of faith who by faith performed mighty deeds and gained strength in weakness
